title_zh: 平衡模组 · 目标位置配对
scope_en: The match variable is a horizontal-distance readout, not a mechanical attraction or success probability. These are simulator replays, not model-generated images.
scope_zh: 匹配变量是水平距离读数，不是机械吸引力或成功概率。画面是仿真重放，不是模型生成图像。
timing: Phase-based speed changes; labels describe recorded replay speed. Reading pauses remain.
